doing:
Mindgruve positions as a media, commerce and data technology company uniting strategy, creative, retail media and engineering to accelerate growth for leading brands: an agency asking to be bought as technology. The headline claim is a growth ranking, Adweek's Fastest Growing Agencies 2026 for a fifth straight year and the Inc. 5000 for an eighth time. Ownership reads independent, HQ San Diego, offices from Denver and New York to Mexico City, São Paulo and Madrid; no founding year or headcount on file.

The sold mix leads with Retail Media, scored 3 on Retail Media & Marketplaces on the homepage, the Macarta and Icon Commerce mergers, the ameo buy and the first independent AMC badge. Three core lines score 2: Data & Measurement (Sightline and the Amazon Marketing Cloud credential), Paid Search (media planning and buying at the core, Google's 2024 Agency Excellence Awards, brand plus generic search guidance) and Web & Product (an in house US engineering team; the eBay web app and Chickasaw Country builds). Sightline is the one proprietary product, listed with no function described.

Its AI posture is thought leadership, not a named service: GEO guides, a JavaScript SEO for AI study, a ChatGPT Ads beta test write up and a 2026-02-19 AI and search webinar led by David Shapiro, VP Global Earned & Owned Media; P1 partial, P8 making.

Moves in date order: 2024-06, the AMC Service Provider badge; 2024-08, merger with Macarta as MindgruveMacarta; 2024-09, merger with Icon Commerce; 2025-02-25, the Outlandish TikTok Shop partnership in Mexico, extended to Brazil 2025-05-07; 2025-06, merger with Levelwing and David Shapiro VP of Earned Media; 2026-01, the ameo acquisition and Spencer Lian Thornton VP of Growth and Partnerships; 2026, the fifth Adweek listing. No pricing signal (P5 unknown), no jobs. Conspicuously absent: a case study for the retail media line it leads with, every case on record being dated 2014 to 2019, and an llms.txt under GEO guides.
clients:
The record reads the client type as enterprise and the home market as the US from San Diego; verticals are consumer brands, food and beverage, healthcare, technology, entertainment, travel and B2B.

22 clients are named, 14 observed and 8 names only; brand and creative leads the mix at 0.393. The observed work is old: Agilent Technologies came for media, leads and commerce as Media Agency of Record (2018-07-19: media credited with record sales growth at a $4.5B company); Bad Boy for web and commerce (2018-07-19: an ecommerce platform); eBay for commerce (2014-11-07: a web application); Budweiser for web, CRM and social (2014-11-07: a March Madness social platform); Chickasaw Country for web (2014-11-07, Digital Agency of Record); California Protons for paid (2018-08-03: patient acquisition); MDVIP for brand, leads and CRM (2014-11-07, after 9 years as Agency of Record); Lakehouse Hotel for brand, paid and web (2018-08-03); Victorinox (2019-12-23: personalized storytelling for Victorinox Swiss Army), Beverly Hills (2014-11-07) and Skullcandy (2019-12-23) for brand. Three observed entries are page titles, not companies: Entertainment Marketing Portfolio, a duplicate Skullcandy entry and a Video page. Names only: Martinelli's, Sony PlayStation, PGA Tour, Oracle, Merck, San Diego Zoo, Scripps Health and a Consumer Marketing Portfolio page. Shared: eBay with dept, Budweiser with iprospect, PGA Tour with brave-bison. Nothing on record names a retail media client.

What the base needs next: the Horus read places Mindgruve best for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation) and most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle hollowed out). The named base is a legacy book and the marketplace advertisers the mergers were made for are absent from the record, so their need is inferred: very likely (moderate confidence) AMC measurement and marketplace growth, likely (low confidence) AI answer visibility as KJ1 moves shopping queries into citations.

openings:
The strongest judgment is the missing case: Mindgruve leads with retail media and bought Macarta, Icon Commerce and ameo to own it, yet no case study on record names a retail media or Amazon client and the case book stops at 2019, so a rival with a dated marketplace result very likely (moderate confidence) out proves it in a pitch to consumer and food and beverage brands. Falsifier: a retail media case study with a client and a date in the next compile.

Second, the say and do failure: it sells paid search and media buying and runs 0 Google ads of its own, so a rival running its own likely (moderate confidence) wins that comparison. Third, the legacy book: eBay, Budweiser and PGA Tour already sit on other tracked books (dept, iprospect, brave-bison) and 8 of the 22 clients are names only, so the enterprise names are contestable on proof. Fourth, integration: three mergers and an acquisition since 2024-08, the MindgruveMacarta name still in its news URLs, are a transition a rival can sell against, low confidence, since the record shows no client loss. No public pricing (P5 unknown) and no llms.txt under GEO guides round out the list.
